name: Zahhak
description: Masked king. Cracked copper-red face mask, tall spiked bone-and-metal crown, long grey-black hair, floor-length black velvet robe. V01 black snakes coiled at shoulders + plain staff; V02 dragon-embroidered robe + old-wood staff; V03 dragon-embroidered robe + cobra staff. Mask, crown and silhouette are constant across all three.

name: Jamshid
description: White mask carved with gold sunburst rosettes, long straight black hair, gold five-point crown, red-and-cream block-print robe over floral lining. Photographed in a pale stone niche.

name: Workers
description: Rough white block masks with protruding peg noses and two drilled eyes. Dyed wool tunics in maroon, olive, teal. Slung stone satchels, wooden digging poles.

name: Craftsmen
description: Block masks with red-clay peg noses. Pink, cream and teal tunics. Carry hand tools, a stone tablet and a basket. Currently exists only inside SHM-REF-001.

name: Fire Priests
description: Long beaked pale masks incised with red sun glyphs, round tasselled side-discs. Red and black layered robes. Hold slender rods and low censers.

name: Royal Warriors
description: Dark green-grey stone block masks with hollow ringed eyes and a heavy carved nose. Hide-and-sackcloth mantles. Long spears, crimson shields with a gold sunburst.

name: Palace Guards
description: Completely featureless pale stone egg-shaped heads, no eyes or mouth. Dark blue-black quilted coats with small dagger loops. Distinct from GRP-004: no carved features, no shields, no spears.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Stone Relief
description: Weathered blue-grey and ochre stone gate, standing horse reliefs on the four flanking slabs, black void doorway, shallow tiered step platform, flat dusk sky.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Cypress Court
description: Tall dark bronze door recessed in a carved sandstone wall, cypresses flanking a stepped ramp, twin stone water channels, warm low sunset light on the stone.

name: Ceremonial Gate - Marble Screen
description: Folded screen of cream and red-veined marble slabs, single tall dark doorway, two rows of cypresses, pale paved approach, near-black storm sky.

name: Mountain Pass
description: Single ochre rock peak rising from an empty rust-coloured plain, pale dirt road winding in from the foreground. Painterly, matte-painting surface texture.

name: Iranian Plateau
description: Late dry season. Grey rocky ridge line across the frame, teal haze sky, rust and sage scrub in the foreground. Establishing wide, no architecture.

name: Hall of Columns
description: Night. Two rows of massive weathered columns, a throne entirely buried under a vast white shroud that pools across the floor, a small gold crown set alone on a plinth beside it, deep blue void beyond the arch.

name: Royal Audience Platform
description: Dark green-black monolithic facade with a torn mountain-like silhouette, tiled pointed-arch doorway, small red-and-gold tiled windows, wide brick step platform, twin pale peaks behind in flat fog.

name: Zahhak Royal Ritual Kitchen
description: Vast low underground vault, pale blue-grey square piers, a small stone hearth with live fire at the far end, the whole floor covered in flower bundles, fruit, grain dishes and dark domed vessels.

name: Ceremonial Reception Hall
description: Wide frontal symmetry. Green-black piers left and right, pale ashlar back wall, low empty stone dais, a row of small oil lamps casting rust stains up the wall, broad tiered steps.

name: Takht-e Jamshid - Throne
description: Small gilded jewelled throne with a rose-and-turquoise back panel, set inside a weathered stone aedicule on a stepped platform, heavy fog rolling across the frame. Hero throne plate.

name: Palace Underlevels
description: Descending secondary circulation. V01 a carved-rock corridor with blue-washed arched niches and one long central stair. V02 a large mudbrick multi-level courtyard with several stairs and small trees. These may be two different places.

name: Staff - Bronze Cobra
description: Twisted dark wood shaft with a bronze hooded cobra head, mouth open, fangs showing. Full turnaround sheet with front, back, head detail and base detail. Carried by CHR-001 in V03.

name: Staff - Plain Old Wood
description: Plain pale weathered wood, no head, slight natural curve, roughly shoulder height. Visible only inside CHR-001 V01 and V02. Deliberately the anti-cobra staff.

name: Diplomatic Gift Set
description: V01 flat-lay on a stone slab: sheathed dagger on black velvet, ornate silver mace, folded crimson gold-thread textiles, black lidded jar, raw crystal, silver casket. V02 staged in a niche: carved stone bird vessel, jewelled textile hanging, tooled belt with gold buckle, gold casket, gold chain.

name: Riding Beast - Pale Beaked
description: Seated. White and pale blue shaggy coat, heavy smooth bone-coloured beak, single short horn, crimson embroidered saddle blanket. Highland scrub setting, dusk.

name: Riding Beast - Long-Beak Black
description: Standing, horse proportions. Black matted dripping coat, very long tapered pale beak, weathered green panel blanket and leather harness. Two small figures in frame for scale. Misty conifer hillside.

name: Riding Beast - Stone Hide
description: Standing, bear-like bulk. Blue lichen-and-stone hide flecked with pale mineral, blunt heavy muzzle, small ears, massive pale splayed claws. Three robed figures for scale on an open plain.

name: Civilization Caste Board
description: 4-up contact sheets. V01 quadrants workers / craftsmen / priests / civilization. V02 quadrants workers / craftsmen / priests / warriors. Source board for GRP-001 through GRP-004.

name: Iranian Nobles
description: Five to eight Iranian nobles and commanders with visible variation between them. Petitioners, not an army: tired irregular spacing, no raised weapons. Masks are smooth continuous human-like surfaces with small eye openings - never skull or skeletal.

name: Iranian Riders
description: Mounted political escort accompanying the delegation. Explicitly not an invading force: no formation, no drawn weapons, harness and travel wear.

name: Jamshid Attendants
description: Jamshid servants and personal guards inside the Hall of Columns. Distinct from GRP-005 palace guards: attendants carry and serve rather than stand post.

name: Approach to Zahhak Domain
description: Cold rocky plain with a distant stone road leading to Zahhak severe stone complex. Wide empty land between converging groups. Overcast, weak crosswind.

name: Zahhak Outer Court
description: Outer courtyard of Zahhak complex where riders and animals wait outside the audience hall.

name: Iran Outskirts
description: Healthy liveable edge of the Iranian city before Zahhak arrives. Partly green, cultivated, intact - deliberately not a post-apocalyptic ruin.

name: Royal Causeway
description: Ascending ramp and stair leading to the seat of power. Built for the rising line of Zahhak entry.

name: Lower Gate - Mount
description: Secondary lower gate where Jamshid mount waits during the escape. Smaller and plainer than the main ceremonial gate.

name: Final Desert
description: Final desert with a fully open horizon and no ridge line. Closing image of the episode.

name: Iranian Royal Banner
description: Official Iranian royal banner. Carried upright by the delegation, then lowered to near-horizontal before Zahhak as a surrendered line.

name: Ritual Vessel
description: Simple stone or metal ritual vessel. Heavy and plain, not treasure - no jewels, coins or decorative glow.

name: Power Insignia
description: Restrained metal insignia of political authority. One of the three limited ceremonial gifts.

name: Jamshid Regalia
description: Royal elements Jamshid can drop during the escape - shed to move faster and to shed the office itself.

name: Mount Harness
description: Entirely functional saddle and harness for the terrestrial mount. Working tack, no ornament.
